evidence.author: Keizers
evidence.identity: Original photograph visibly shows the Tucano storefront beneath Congress Hall at Iulius Town. The TUCANO sign is partly obscured by an existing tree, but the storefront mural, entrance and terrace are present. This is a focused crop of the real cafe, rather than a generic mall view. The official Iulius Town directory identifies the branch as Tucano Coffee (Venezuela). Revo.js 2023 venue access directions independently place Tucano directly below Congress Hall with escalators to its right, matching the uncropped image.
evidence.rightsEvidence: Individual Wikimedia Commons file page identifies Keizers as author, Own work as source, and an explicit copyright-holder grant under CC BY-SA 4.0. The grant covers reuse and adaptations with credit and share-alike.
evidence.transform: Cropped original 4032×3024 image to pixel rectangle [200,1300,1970,2500] to focus on the cafe facade and terrace; resized to 1200×814 and converted to WebP at quality 86. No retouching or generated content. Adapted photo remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
evidence.visualQA: Inspected original and final storefront crop. The left storefront, colorful mural, doorway, terrace and partial original TUCANO sign remain visible; a tree obscures part of the sign.
evidence.limitations: Archive image dated September 2019 in six-language alt text and captions. No claim of current furnishings/layout. Original smartphone night image has visible grain.
